title: The Hulk learns to calm down.
lines: Bruce Banner is a calm man.
He wears glasses, he likes reading books and he works in a laboratory.
There he does experiments with tubes and bottles.
He is very clever and very friendly.
When he gets very angry, something happens.
He grows and grows, until he's as big as a house.
He can lift a car with one hand.
He can jump as high as a tower.
But the Hulk doesn't think very well.
When he's angry, he smashes things.
One day Bruce is sitting on a bench in the park.
A little boy is sitting next to him.
Tibo has built a tower of blocks.
But then a football comes rolling along.
He knows that feeling very well.
He sits down next to Tibo.
You know, Tibo, he says, sometimes I get very angry too.
So angry that I turn green.
And then I turn into the Hulk.
Bruce puts his finger to his lips.
But do you know what I've learned?
But what you do when you're angry, that's what matters.
I have three tricks, says Bruce.
Do you want to learn them?
Pretend you're blowing up a big balloon.
Breathe in through your nose, really deeply, right down into your tummy.
And then blow out very slowly, through your mouth.
Tibo feels his tummy getting a little calmer.
One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten.
Tibo's hands aren't clenched so tight anymore.
Not with your hands or your feet.
I'm angry, he says, because my tower fell down.
I worked on it for so long.
Then a girl comes running up.
Shall I help you build a new tower?
And together they build a new tower.
Even taller than the first one!
But then a big dog comes past.
And then Tibo starts to laugh.
He laughs so hard that the girl has to laugh too.
Breathing, counting and talking, says Tibo.
That evening, at home, Tibo's cup of milk falls over.
But then he takes a deep breath.
And he says: Mummy, my milk fell over.
I learned it from a friend, he says.
A friend who sometimes turns green.
